scope: Native correctness follow-up; no hardware, package publication or physical modem drain guarantee. Prior immutable simulator/network results retain their original source identities.

prior_evidence.guard_race: The previously theoretical precheck-to-Fire interleaving was forced with barriers. A separate actual busy transport reproduction allowed Clear/new Fire while an earlier accepted automatic abort remained pending. These prompted the ownership fix; no captured field event is attributed to them.

implementation.launch_exclusion: Persisted Saved.automatic_abort_claimed and runtime dispatch/clear reservation share the existing per-GSE mutex with commit_fire_intent. Claim-first blocks Fire; committed Fire denies new automatic claims. Router callbacks run with no GSE mutex held.
implementation.durability: A failed claim save still queues the critical automatic abort; the RAM claim and storage error prevent Fire. Ordinary reset/requalification and restart do not erase the claim. Only successful explicit Clear saves it false after other fallible work. Missing old JSON field defaults false.
implementation.dispatch: Automatic producers use accepted TX ownership; manual Abort retains its separate existing RX path and authority. Both actual queued command consumer and direct safety dispatcher are covered. Queue admission failure is logged without falsely reporting a sent command. HITL retains its separate behavior.
implementation.clear: Clear reserves against new automatic producers/Fire, then checks SDK ownership first and GS software queues second without holding GSE. Unknown packed SDK work and unrelated active callbacks conservatively block without unpacking/pinning. Typed unrelated queued work does not require a global drain. Pending software counters cover queue-pop/active-write/retry and mesh queue ownership. No queue is purged.
implementation.sdk_scope: Host-only active queued-TX counter starts under the same state lock as each of two queue-pop sites, and RAII ends after dispatch/cleanup. Read-only type query includes accepted originals, replay and reliable owners. It excludes RX-originated ownership. Embedded builds gain no counter or hot-path atomic operation.
implementation.recovery_ui: Status exposes persisted automatic abort latch; frontend dev Clear button accepts the optional bool with missing=false. Clear remains disallowed during Fire/Launch and preserves existing permissions.

positive_and_negative_cases: Claim first versus Fire first, with controlled barriers.
Persistence failure still dispatches ABORT; storage/queue/clear failure does not rearm.
Restart restores latch and explicit Clear remains reachable after late FC Idle.
Actual accepted SDK retry stays observable while callback is paused, for both worker entry points.
No-peer SDK handoff to software transport still blocks Clear.
Busy codec chunks, reliable replay/actual ACK, and panic cleanup retain ownership correctly.
Actual GB ACK releases ownership; unrelated queued FLIGHT_BUZZER does not block Clear.
Existing manual Abort authority and HITL policy remain separate.
limits: This does not assert that an external modem FIFO, over-air transmission or remote board has physically drained when GS software ownership ends. No-peer broadcast has no remote ACK proof.
Unclassified packed work and any active host queued-TX callback conservatively delay Clear; retry can be necessary under network activity.
Linked end-to-end flight/network runs for the new exact source commits remain pending; earlier cohorts are not relabeled.
